newsitem.title: USA: Grancare names Keith Yoder CFO.
newsitem.headline: Grancare names Keith Yoder CFO.

text.p: GranCare Inc said Thursday it has named Keith Yoder chief financial officer, replacing Jerry Schneider.
Yoder, formerly senior vice president, controller and treasurer, joined GranCare in 1995 when the company acquired Evergreen Healthcare Inc, where he was chief financial officer, it said.

Yoder replaces Jerry Schneider, GranCare's chief financial officer since January 1995, who is joining the North American unit of Fresenius AG Medical Care North America, also as chief financial officer, it said.
The company said Clark Hettinga, assistant controller, has been promoted as controller. The position of senior vice president and treasurer will not be filled, it said.
GranCare provides specialty medical services and long-term care.
